name: ACMG_evidence_collector
description: Primary ToolUniverse ACMG evidence collector for germline variant review. Accepts transcript HGVS, gene;transcript:c. HGVS, genomic HGVS/VCF-like input, rsID, gene plus c. shorthand, or gene plus p. HGVS. Coding shorthand is resolved through VariantValidator MANE transcript tools; protein shorthand is resolved through Ensembl VEP and then MANE projection, with ambiguity failing closed. This tool collects and displays evidence from ToolUniverse data sources and deterministic ClinGen/SVI overlay logic for user judgment. It does not automatically produce final ACMG/AMP classifications, does not adopt ClinVar, GeneBe, InterVar, or other source labels as criteria, and reports conflicts and Bayesian estimates as review aids only.

variant.description: Transcript HGVS, gene;transcript:c. HGVS, genomic HGVS/VCF-like variant, rsID, gene plus c. shorthand, or gene plus p. HGVS, e.g. NM_000142.5:c.1075+95C>G, BRCA2;NM_000059.4:c.5946delT, rs80359550, BRCA2 c.5946delT, or BRCA2 p.Ser1982ArgfsTer22. Coding shorthand uses VariantValidator MANE resolution; protein shorthand uses Ensembl VEP followed by MANE projection.

transcript.description: Transcript accession or transcript context, if known.

disease.description: Disease name or MONDO identifier used to match an applicable ClinGen CSpec.

inheritance.description: Inheritance mode used to match an applicable ClinGen CSpec.

genome_build.description: Genome assembly. hg19/hg38 normalize to GRCh37/GRCh38; coordinate inputs without an explicit or accession-inferred build fail closed.

source_outputs_or_leads.description: Existing outputs from GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, ClinGen, SpliceAI, MyVariant, VEP, papers, labs, or other tools. These are normalized as traceable source leads; only identity-consistent, criterion-valid source-backed candidates may enter automatic Bayesian review, while verified Bayesian review remains stricter.

literature_proposals.description: Optional supplemental literature facts or reproducibility input. The collector normally retrieves and extracts source-backed candidates itself; submitted proposals are re-anchored to the cited document and cannot override fact-type or strength rules.

cspec_proposals.description: Optional supplemental interpretations of unresolved natural-language rules from an online ClinGen CSpec. ToolUniverse normally executes its finite condition evaluator first, then re-fetches and verifies the specification ID, version, content hash, criterion, and excerpt for any submitted proposal.

evidence_decisions.description: User decisions applied only to stable card IDs regenerated in this call. Accept or reject a card; an accepted card may use a direction-consistent standard strength override when a reason is supplied.

clinical_context.description: Review-only clinical context. Explicit HPO terms trigger term/gene/disease lookups; all matches remain PP4 review context and never generate PP4 automatically.

hpo_terms.description: HPO identifiers in HP:0001250, HP_0001250, or bare numeric form.

clinical_observations.description: Structured caller-supplied case, family, phase, phenotype, assay, case-control, or case-series observations. These may create automatic source-backed candidates but enter the verified estimate only when independently re-anchored to a retrievable provider or document fact.

response_detail.description: Output detail level. 'summary' (default) returns compact source-fact/evidence-card indexes plus ID/decision-only compatibility, Bayesian, and criterion-review reports; 'full' returns complete audit payloads.

provider_failures.description: Summary-only provider failure groups with tool names, failure code, attempts, dataset and release.

variant_scope.description: Pre-provider build and small-variant/SV scope decision.

clinical_context.description: Review-only clinical context echo; never evidence.

consequence_profile.description: Identity-bound, multi-provider selected-transcript consequence profile used for criterion applicability routing.

observations.description: All authoritative, aggregation, normalization-context, alternate-transcript, empty, and failed consequence observations. Empty/no-hit/failed rows are not negative votes.

equivalent_or_alternate_representations.description: Provider HGVS descriptions retained as normalization or alternate representations; string differences alone are non-veto context.

spliceai_profile.description: Identity-selected transcript SpliceAI four-channel profile plus separately named provider-global maximum context.

spliceai_max_delta.description: Maximum of the selected-transcript DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, and DS_DL values.

canonical_motif_sequence_status.description: REF/ALT or HGVS sequence-level motif status; functional native-site loss is reported separately in spliceai_profile.

runtime_manifest.description: Installed runtime, collector schema, deterministic ruleset hash, VCS provenance when available, and applicable dynamic CSpec identities.

guard_context.description: Compact self-checking claim contract for ACMG_guard_final_answer. Contains schema_version, variant_identity_hash, ruleset_hash, representative-card claims, criterion_review_claims, and context_hash; review claims permit accurate discussion but are not EvidenceCards or Bayesian inputs.

source_facts.description: Normalized provider or document facts supporting reviewable EvidenceCards and automatic or verified calculation roles.

failure_details.description: Structured no-hit, identity-conflict, provider-failure, or malformed-contract diagnostics.

prior_variant_candidates.description: Same-residue germline-compatible prior-variant leads. Database labels remain review-only until independently anchored literature facts validate PS1 or PM5.

literature_candidates.description: Cross-provider deduplicated literature index preserving all LitVar, Europe PMC, and PubMed source hits. Summary rows inherit any common fields from literature_candidate_defaults.

literature_candidate_defaults.description: Common summary-only fields omitted from every literature candidate row to avoid repeated payload. Merge these defaults into each row when reading the compact index.

literature_review.description: Deduplicated candidates, verified full-text state, deterministic fact extraction, optional supplemental review requests, reading manifests, and proposal validation status.

review_readiness.description: Auditable evidence-review readiness. This is workflow completeness, not a five-tier classification.

rule_evaluation.description: Observed inputs, applicable rule and threshold, condition status, one primary reason, and secondary caveats.

name: ACMG_overlay_gate_assess_variant
description: Thin backward-compatible alias for ACMG_evidence_collector. Parameters and return structure are identical; the alias contains no independent assessment logic.

name: ACMG_population_evidence
description: Apply deterministic ClinGen/SVI population evidence rules and return EvidenceCards only.

callability_available.description: Whether auditable site callability rows were supplied; this is not a coverage threshold assertion.

population_details.description: Raw dataset, callset, homozygote, and ancestry-frequency audit fields.

callability_metrics.description: Raw gnomAD site coverage metrics; no adequacy threshold is inferred.

name: ACMG_computational_evidence
description: Apply the pre-specified computational predictor policy and return EvidenceCards only.

spliceai_max_delta.description: Explicit four-channel maximum delta score. Complete DS_*/DP_* values are still required for rule assessment.

spliceai_profile.description: Normalized selected-transcript SpliceAI profile containing all four DS_*/DP_*, maximum triggers, native Loss score/position/threshold, exact Ensembl exon-boundary binding, genomic event coordinate, and Gain events restricted to +/-20 bp around that canonical site.

spliceai_scores.description: Selected-transcript SpliceAI score row. DS_AG/DS_AL/DS_DG/DS_DL are delta scores and must not be recomputed from REF/ALT raw scores.

spliceai_run_metadata.description: Walker 2023 run provenance. Missing or incomplete metadata prevents a positive PP3/BP4 EvidenceCard while all available scores remain visible.

name: ACMG_clinical_evidence
description: Review structured de novo and PM3 observations; only the collector can validate and count them.

name: ACMG_functional_evidence
description: Review structured functional assays under Brnich OddsPath; only the collector can validate and count them.

consequence_profile.description: Review-only normalized consequence context. Caller-provided values cannot make direct group cards countable.

protein_context.description: Review-only protein mapping and domain/site facts. Collector-normalized SourceFacts are required for automatic or verified calculation roles.

pvs1_facts.description: Review-only structured facts for the deterministic ClinGen SVI PVS1 decision tree (Abou Tayoun 2018; Walker 2023 SpliceAI thresholds).

name: ACMG_literature_evidence
description: Review structured case-control facts. Direct group-tool cards are always review-only; the collector re-fetches full text and verifies identity, locators, and field excerpts before candidate inclusion.

case_control_facts.description: Standalone review facts. The collector must normalize their identity, source, target link, and minimum fields before automatic or verified calculation.

expected_variant.description: Variant identity used to bind standalone structured facts.

expected_gene.description: Gene symbol used to bind standalone structured facts.

name: ACMG_guard_final_answer
description: Fail-closed guard for ACMG wording. Criterion discussion is allowed when it references an EvidenceCard or a compact criterion review claim; review claims never become evidence or Bayesian inputs. Final five-tier ToolUniverse classifications are always blocked.

evidence_cards.description: Compatibility input. Each bare card must contain a legal criterion, strength, evidence status, and at least one source_fact_id.

guard_context.description: Preferred lightweight input. Pass the collector's schema_version, variant_identity_hash, ruleset_hash, claims, criterion_review_claims, and context_hash object unchanged. Invalid or modified contexts fail closed.
